# Anthony Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** School student  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P3](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a small, dark, and gloomy face with black eyes. He typically looks sullen and disdainful.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)_

## Personality

Anthony is cheeky, defiant, and insolent, harboring a stubborn self-reliance and disdain for authority. He holds a prejudice against female educators, believing them to be useless. Despite his sullen disposition, he is clever and capable of showing respect once his boundaries are established.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P30](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0030), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_

- cheeky  <sub>[v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)</sub>

## History

Anthony Tulk moved to Brierley to reside with his aunt, Mrs. Laurence Tulk, and enrolled as a new student at the local school taught by Nell Harcourt. From his arrival, he displayed enmity toward Nell and held the view that female teachers were ineffective. He frequently misbehaved, such as pouring water down a classmate's neck and placing a live mouse inside Nell's desk drawer. After being whipped with a hardwood pointer for the mouse prank, his stubborn defiance gave way and he developed a newfound respect for Nell, even offering to carry her books and declaring her punishment to be as effective as a man's. When Nell later resigned as teacher, Anthony engaged in two deliberate fights with other boys to process his emotions.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P29](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0029), [v2 c12 P30](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0030), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052), [v2 c26 P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_
